# YeahSight

> YeahSight gives a clear, structured view of how society works and where it is heading. It covers four domains: environment & energy, economy & equity, technology & automation, and social organization, and ends with a proposed roadmap for society. YeahSight is an initiative of HappyBein, a Dutch foundation (Stichting) based in Eindhoven whose idea is that structured understanding unlocks solutions. All articles are available in English and French.

## Start here

- [Foresight Trends](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/foresight-trends/): what foresight is and an overview of all trend areas
- [Vision & Roadmap](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/vision-roadmap/): the six proposed steps towards a fairer, safer world

## Environment & Energy

- [Climate Change](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/climate-change/): what is warming the planet, how far it has gone, and what it changes for people
- [Nature and Water](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/nature-and-water/): the living systems and fresh water every economy depends on, and the pressure they are under
- [Land per Person](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/land-per-person/): global land use broken down per person
- [Fair Space Sharing](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/fair-space-sharing/): a proposal for sharing land between humans and wildlife
- [Clean & Safe Energy](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/clean-safe-energy/): energy sources compared, and the path to renewables
- [Plant-Based Consumption](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/plant-based-consumption/): how diet connects to land, climate and animal welfare

## Economy & Equity

- [Universal Allowance](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/universal-allowance/): a guaranteed, purpose-bound budget for basic needs
- [The Economic System](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/economic-system/): how economic systems work and shape outcomes
- [Fair Globe Sharing](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/fair-globe-sharing/): what a fair distribution of the world's resources could look like
- [Inheritance](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/inheritance/): how inheritance carries inequity forward, and a proposal for redistribution
- [From Inherited Wealth to a Fair Start](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/making-the-transition/): a proposed step-by-step path from inherited financial unfairness to a fair and sustainable society, including how countries can go first without losing out
- [Who's Working on This](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/who-is-working-on-this/): a filterable directory of organisations working on pieces of that path (tax justice, inheritance and wealth, basic income, citizens' assemblies, carbon pricing)

## Technology & Automation

- [Enhanced Automation](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/enhanced-automation/)
- [Impact of Artificial Intelligence](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/impact-of-artificial-intelligence/)
- [Life After Automation](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/life-after-automation/)
- [Big Risks: Pandemics, Nuclear War, Advanced AI](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/big-risks/): rare events that could set humanity back for generations, and what lowers the risk

## Social Organization

- [What Is Society For?](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/purpose-of-society/)
- [What Every Society Must Do](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/societal-functions/)
- [Who Keeps Society Running?](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/societal-systems/): the four kinds of actors (state, markets, communities, families) and the main public systems
- [Democracy and Reliable Information](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/democracy-and-information/): how societies make shared choices, and why that depends on trustworthy information
- [Global Health and Extreme Poverty](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/global-health-and-poverty/): how far the world has come, and who is still left behind
- [How Societies Change](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/how-societies-change/): what drives big changes and what makes them last
- [Social Redistribution](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/social-redistribution/)
- [Managing Regional Migration](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/managing-regional-migration/)
- [Population Change and Ageing](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/population-change/): fewer children, longer lives, and what it changes for care, pensions and work
